title: High Protein Cheesy Breakfast Bites
summary: Ingredients * 2 eggs * 1 cup cottage cheese * 1 cup almond flour * ½ cup shredded cheddar cheese * ½ tsp baking soda Instructions 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
steps: In a mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs and cottage cheese.
Stir in the almond flour and baking soda until well combined.
Fold in the shredded cheddar cheese.
Scoop the mixture into a greased mini muffin tin or onto a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 25–30 minutes, or until the tops are golden and the centers are fully cooked.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
